row.evidence: Datto RMM's docs say it 'supports single sign-on with KaseyaOne' with 'just-in-time provisioning' and automatic deactivation when the KaseyaOne user is removed; no SCIM endpoint appears in the RMM, Workplace or Partner Portal help sitemaps or the RMM API.
row.notes: New row; Datto (a Kaseya company) sells only to MSP partners with customised pricing ('Request Pricing'), so price fields are null. Researched Datto RMM as the main admin product, with Datto Workplace, File Protection and the Partner Portal noted. No SCIM in any Datto product docs. Datto RMM users are created by admins, or JIT on first sign-in through KaseyaOne Unified Login (Kaseya's own identity hub, which can sync groups from a third-party IdP); KaseyaOne groups map to RMM security levels nightly, and Automatic User Deprovisioning deactivates the RMM user when the KaseyaOne user is deactivated or deleted. Datto Workplace offers SAML 2.0 SSO (Okta, Ping, Entra guides) and a vendor-run daily Entra ID user and group sync. Okta OIN: Datto Workplace and File Protection are SAML only, Partner Portal is SWA. Entra gallery: Workplace and File Protection SSO tutorials. The RMM REST API (OAuth 2.0 from per-user keys) lists users and exposes activity logs but has no user write endpoints. 'None' is by absence (rule 5).

plans.name: Datto partner pricing (MSP)
plans.notes: No public tiers; Datto RMM priced per partner agreement.

scim.notes: No SCIM page in the Datto RMM help sitemap (321 pages), the Datto Workplace help sitemap, or the Datto continuity/Partner Portal help sitemap (798 pages), and no SCIM resource in the RMM API. Datto RMM user automation runs through KaseyaOne Unified Login (JIT creation, nightly group-to-security-level mapping, automatic deactivation when the KaseyaOne user is deactivated or deleted). 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

auth.notes: API key and secret generated per user (Setup > Users > Generate API Keys) and exchanged for an OAuth 2.0 token that expires after 100 hours; permissions follow the user's API security level.

rate_limits.text: 600 read requests and 100 write requests per rolling 60 seconds per account; 429 when exceeded, then temporary IP block (403) on persistent requests.

limitations.text: The documented user endpoint is read-only (list users); user creation, update and deletion are not in the API permission tables.
API keys of inactive or deleted users stop working.

okta.notes: OIN 'Datto Workplace' (Sep. 13 2022) and 'Datto File Protection' (Jun. 20 2023) mark only SAML; 'Datto Partner Portal' (Oct. 30 2015) marks only SWA (page markup). No Datto RMM app found.

entra.notes: Gallery tutorials for Datto Workplace and Datto File Protection SSO (SP and IdP initiated); no provisioning tutorial. Workplace separately runs its own Entra ID user/group sync (fallbacks.other_sync).

fallbacks.other_sync: Datto RMM: KaseyaOne Unified Login (JIT creation, nightly group-to-security-level sync, automatic deactivation). Datto Workplace: vendor-run daily Microsoft Entra ID user and group sync.
fallbacks.notes: JIT is through KaseyaOne (Kaseya's own identity hub), not SAML/OIDC directly from the customer's IdP.
